content:
shilpa: Heads-up — compliance flagged a permission-change batch on 2025-05-12 with no actor in the audit.

mike: ...which batch? link to report?

shilpa: https://internal.reports/compliance/2025-05-12 — it's the role_sync job that moved 42 users into 'data-analyst-lite'. audit entries show `actor: null` and `source: role-reconciler`.

eva: omg. is this the new reconciler refactor we rolled last week?

mike: We did push the role-reconciler v2 on 05-11. It switched from calling our auth-api to writing via the rbac-proxy, maybe metadata not propagated.

sec-bot: Incident detection: 42 perm-changes with missing actor detected. Suggested action: assign quick triage.

shilpa: Assigning triage to @mike @oliver. mike — can you run an audit DB query for those change_ids and post the raw event JSON?

mike: Running now. snippet: ```sql
SELECT id, change_set, actor, source, created_at FROM rbac_audit WHERE change_set->>'role' = 'data-analyst-lite' AND created_at >= '2025-05-11';
```

mike: Results: 42 rows; actor is NULL for all; source = "role-reconciler"; change_payload shows user_ids.

oliver: Check CI/infra — maybe the reconciler job used a service principal and we lost the header mapping. @eva can you check the reconciler logs and the request headers it emitted when writing the changes?

eva: looked at reconciler logs (linked). The reconciler calls `POST /rbac/v1/bulk` via rbac-proxy. Proxy logs show `x-actor` present, but our audit-ingest pipeline drops `actor` when source == 'role-reconciler' due to a legacy branch.

mike: ah, the legacy branch path for `role-reconciler` was left in place during the refactor. It only filled `actor` if `x-actor` matched a user header; service principals were ignored.

shilpa: So compliance expects a non-null actor for all permission changes. Can we reconstruct actor attribution from CI/commit metadata if the reconciler ran from pipeline? 

oliver: yes — the reconciler includes `job_id` and `git_sha` in the payload. We can map `job_id` -> CI job -> executor identity. Might get us the service account that triggered it.

mike: For immediate mitigation, I've created a short-term policy: block bulk role syncs that result in null actor and put them into a pending queue. Patch PR: `rbac-audit: preserve-actor-for-service-principals` in review — includes unit tests.

shilpa: Please attach PR link and ETA.

mike: PR: https://git.internal/r/reconciler/+/8342 . ETA for deploy to canary: 3 hours. Will also backfill actor for the 42 rows using CI job mapping.

eva: Backfill plan: run a script to join rbac_audit -> reconciler_payload.job_id -> ci_runs to extract `executor_email` and write `actor` via safe patch with audit metadata. I'll run in staging then prod after approval.

sec-bot: Action logged: triage assigned to mike, oliver; patch PR opened; backfill scheduled.

shilpa: Good. For compliance reporting: we need a brief note that explains root cause (refactor left legacy branch dropping actor for service principals), mitigation (block null-actor bulk writes, PR fix), and remediation (backfill + add monitoring alert). I'll draft the note.

mike: One more ask — can eng-sre validate that KMS/HSM integration wasn't involved? The reconciler signs requests with its KMS key; want to ensure no key rotation or KMS-error coincided.

eva: Checked KMS logs: no rotates or failures at that time. KMS calls successful for sign operations.

oliver: I'll open a follow-up story to add an invariant test in the audit pipeline: reject entries where source in ('role-reconciler','terraform-sync') and actor is null.

shilpa: Thanks everyone. Filing compliance ticket and sending the note once PR's green. :thumbsup:

mike: Deploying canary now. will post status.

sec-bot: Deploy bot: canary deployment of reconciler v2 fix successful on canary cluster.

mike: Canary passed. Rolling to prod in 30m.

shilpa: After prod is live, run backfill and update compliance report.

eva: will do. once backfill completes, will post summary with counts and artifacts.

oliver: tagging @compliance for visibility.

compliance: thanks — please add the audit query and backfill script to the ticket so we can archive.

shilpa: Will do. Closing triage after backfill verification.
